text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5.Certification of no criminal record Original copy of notarized copy in Chinese or English 6.English proficiency test certificate The medicine taught in English need to supply the proof of IELTS score reaches 6.5 or TOEFL score reaches 80.Original copy of notarized copy in Chinese or English. 7.Health certificate Not needed during application. But may required when applying for visa. 8.Two Letter of Recommendation Original copy of notarized copy in Chinese or Englis from professor or associate professor or equivalents. 9.Study plan more than 1000 words 10.Internship Certificate (for medical programs) Original copy of notarized copy in Chinese or English. 11.Financial support statement Original copy or notarized copy in Chinese or English of the financial support statement with signature
